# Three.js 0.180.0

The two unmodified ESM build files in this folder come from the official `three@0.180.0` npm package. They are vendored to keep the classroom self-contained; no third-party network request is needed at runtime. The MIT license is included.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.180.0.tgz

`sha512-o+qycAMZrh+TsE01GqWUxUIKR1AL0S8pq7zDkYOQw8GqfX8b8VoCKYUoHbhiX5j+7hr8XsuHDVU6+gkQJQKg9w==`

Refresh from the official registry with TLS and integrity verification enabled, using the same pinned version. Do not replace the library with an unpinned CDN import.
